additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am writing because the terminal screen does not turn on. It remains black
despite a reboot.
Please schedule an intervention to check the
connectors? Is it possible that your provider has a
screen? Like this, if the screen needs to be changed, no need to
provide for a second intervention.
Thank you in advance for your answer
